blocks.text: Judges 12 contains 15 verses. It opens with: And the men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thy house upon thee with fire. It concludes with: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill-country of the Amalekites. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The programmatic pattern in Judges 2 guides the central narratives, but the individual episodes do not all contain every stage or follow a mechanically identical cycle.
